Measure points are assumed Rx therefore N/A for Link Fail Seconds – Out, Severely Errored Seconds – Out, Errored Seconds – Out

SELECT
  time_sec,
  value,
  CASE WHEN sourcename LIKE 'T%' THEN sourcename
	   WHEN sourcename LIKE 'B%' THEN sourcename
  ELSE concat(substring(sourcename,1,4),"-",vendor,":",SUBSTRING_INDEX(sourcename, ":", -1)) END as metric
FROM 
(
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tems.`Date/Time`) as time_sec,
  tems.`Link Fail Seconds - In` as value,
  LEFT(tems.`PM Source`,35) as metric2,
  tems.customer_sid,
  tems.node_id,
  cnf.sourcename,
  cnf.nodeid,
  cnf.vendor,
  cnf.serviceid
FROM tems_och tems, configuration cnf
WHERE $__timeFilter(tems.`Date/Time`) and
tems.`PM Source` not like '%OTM%' and
tems.`PM Source` in ($pm_source) and 
(tems.`customer_sid` = '$service_id' or tems.`customer_sid` is null) 
ORDER BY   tems.`Date/Time`, metric2 ASC
)temp_tbl
where temp_tbl.`metric2`=sourcename AND CASE WHEN temp_tbl.`customer_sid` IS NOT NULL THEN temp_tbl.`customer_sid`=serviceid ELSE true end
ORDER BY time_sec ASC;

list.definition: SELECT ser.serviceid FROM pm_db.service ser, customer cus where ser.active=1 AND  cus.name = "$customer" and ser.customer_id = cus.id AND CASE WHEN startdate IS NOT NULL THEN startdate<=SYSDATE() ELSE true end AND CASE WHEN enddate IS NOT NULL THEN enddate >= SYSDATE() ELSE true end group by serviceid
list.label: Service ID
list.name: service_id
